source: Keraal Group 3: 539 recordings, 3 healthy participants, phone-style pose (BlazePose, un-mirrored, pixel units) vs Vicon. Reference: Vicon joint angles from segment orientations; trunk lean vs Vicon trunk tilt. Scripts: evaluate_vicon_quaternions.py, diagnose_arm_reference.py, evaluate_keraal_vicon_offsetfree.py.

modes.range: Absolute angles and range of motion may be shown, with the stated typical error.
modes.relative: Timing and change relative to the patient's own start pose or reference rep may be shown; not absolute degrees.
modes.timing_only: Only when the movement happens (rep detection, holds, tempo); no sizes.
modes.not_reportable: Do not show or use for feedback.

arm_elevation.definition: Signed arm angle in the image plane against the shoulder-line perpendicular; 0 = down, 90 = out, 180 = overhead.

CTK.note: Arms raised forwards to shoulder height: median range error under 5 deg, typical 10-18 deg per recording.

RTK.note: Arms held during trunk rotation: median range error about 2 deg.

ELK.note: Overhead reach: timing reliable; absolute range reads about 25 deg high (8 deg for one participant, ~30 deg for two).

overhead_rule.note: Arm above shoulder height: range reads high; report change only.

elbow_flexion.definition: Elbow bend in the image plane; 0 = straight.

ELK.note: Arm moving sideways: range within 0-9 deg of Vicon.

CTK.note: Forearm points at the camera: range reads about twice too large.

trunk_lean.definition: Sideways tilt of the hip-to-shoulder line from the image vertical; + = towards the person's left. This is tilt from vertical, not chest-versus-pelvis angle (about 25 deg larger in ELK).

ELK.note: Flank stretch: near-exact (median error 2.4 deg, range within 5 deg).

RTK.note: Small lean during rotation: detectable as change, size under-read by about 27 deg.

CTK.note: Hardly any trunk movement in this exercise; signal is mostly noise.

trunk_rotation.definition: Shoulder-line twist about the vertical, from BlazePose relative depth.

default.note: Only validated for the torso rotation exercise.

RTK.note: Rotation timing reliable; size reads more than twice the spine rotation (depth estimate).

CTK.name: hiding face
CTK.description: Arms raised forwards, flexed about 90 deg at shoulder and elbow, hands in front of the face.

ELK.name: flank stretch
ELK.description: One arm reaches overhead while the trunk bends sideways; the other arm stays along the body.

RTK.name: torso rotation
RTK.description: Arms raised, trunk rotates to each side.

known_errors._note: Keraal error descriptions per exercise; error numbers (E1-E3) and thresholds to confirm against the Group 1A/2A Anvil labels.

ELK.description: opposite arm not along the body

CTK.gap: needs a new measure (e.g. elbow spread relative to shoulder width); not yet validated

CTK.description: third error variant (listed as 'arms not raised enough' in the paper)
CTK.gap: confirm meaning from the Anvil labels
